propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherited generic 16,000-token output, three structured-generation retries, and 600-second timeout budgets, causing 216–311 second execution times on malformed candidate-id responses before safe abstention.

RunRequest lacks operation-local bounds for output tokens, structured-retry attempts, transport attempts, and request timeout, permitting the generic policy to make three full generations before advisory abstention.
Schema validation and token caps alone are insufficient containment; token-capped mutations still retried three times, and length validators only reject after oversized payloads exist.

The repair adds lowering-only seams to RunRequest for structured-retry, transport-attempt, and timeout; applies them in runner._effective_config before model construction; and enforces explicit advisory budgets (1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, 60-second timeout) in judge_batch calls.
